name: cicode-vscode-extension
description: Syntax highlighting and navigation for Cicode

commands.title: Cicode: Insert Doc Skeleton for Function

cicode.explorer.expandFolders.description: Expand folders by default in the Cicode Explorer.

cicode.indexing.excludePatterns.description: Regular expressions matched against workspace-relative file paths to exclude from indexing.

cicode.indexing.includeProjectPath.description: Folder of the Include project, or its labels.DBF. The compiler adds Include to every project, so its labels are known in every file. Empty: found automatically (the project named Include in the MASTER.DBF of the User folder above the workspace, then under cicode.avevaPath, then in the User folders of the installed Plant SCADA versions, the one belonging to cicode.avevaPath first). Not used when the workspace contains the Include project.

cicode.signatureOverrides.description: Override or add function signatures. Each entry is a Cicode signature string, e.g. "STRING MyFormat(STRING sText, [STRING sPicture])" or "INT MyInit()". Optional parameters use square brackets or a default value ("INT nMode = 0"). Built-in signatures come from the compiler's own function table (Bin\FUNC0.DBF), so overrides are only needed for functions it doesn't know.

cicode.avevaPath.description: Path to the AVEVA Plant SCADA installation folder. The extension reads the compiler's built-in function table from its Bin folder (Bin\FUNC0.DBF) and finds the help files automatically.

cicode.helpServerUrl.description: Root URL of the local AVEVA help server (Product Help Viewer Service, 2023 R2 and later), used by 'Open full help' and the 'Cicode: Open Help for Symbol' command.

cicode.hover.showHelpLink.description: Show an 'Open full help' link in hovers of functions that have an AVEVA help page.

cicode.format.maxConsecutiveBlankLines.description: Collapse runs of blank lines to this maximum (not inside parentheses, strings or comments).

cicode.lint.enable.description: Enable light lint diagnostics for common best practices.

cicode.lint.maxLineLength.description: Warn when lines exceed this length (0 = disable).

cicode.lint.warnMixedIndent.description: Warn on mixing tabs and spaces at line starts.

cicode.lint.warnMissingSemicolons.description: Hint when a declaration has no trailing semicolon. Style only: the compiler never requires a semicolon.

cicode.lint.warnKeywordCase.description: Suggest upper-case keywords (END, IF, ...). Style only: keywords are case-insensitive; upper case is the AVEVA convention. Does not auto-fix.

cicode.lint.warnUnusedVariables.description: Warn about variables that are declared but never used.

cicode.diagnostics.warnInvalidTypes.description: Report declarations whose type is not one of the six Cicode types (INT, REAL, STRING, OBJECT, QUALITY, TIMESTAMP), e.g. the tag types LONG, DIGITAL or BYTE. The compiler rejects such a parameter, module or global variable or return type; a local one declares nothing (the words are read as tags).

cicode.diagnostics.warnUndeclaredVariabl.description: Warn about names that are not a declared variable, function or label. The compiler reads such a name as a variable tag (W1007 Tag not defined when the project has none); tags are not indexed, so this is off by default.

cicode.diagnostics.ignoredUndeclaredVari.description: Regex patterns for variable names to exclude from the undeclared variable check (e.g. "^My_").

cicode.lint.maxCallNestingDepth.description: Warn when function calls are nested deeper than this level (0 = disable).

cicode.lint.maxBlockNestingDepth.description: Warn when control flow blocks (IF/FOR/WHILE/etc.) are nested deeper than this level (0 = disable).

cicode.lint.warnMagicNumbers.description: Warn about hardcoded numeric literals (excludes 0, 1, -1, and array indices).

cicode.diagnostics.warnDeclarationsInBlo.description: Report variable declarations inside IF, WHILE, FOR or SELECT blocks, which the compiler rejects (E2041).

cicode.diagnostics.ignoredFunctions.description: Regex patterns for function names to exclude from undefined and argument count checks (e.g. "^My_").

cicode.codeLens.enable.description: Show reference counts above function definitions.

cicode.documentation.docskeleton.useBloc.description: Style of comments used for the doc skeleton

cicode.documentation.docskeleton.doxygen.description: The style of doxygen commands to be used by the doc skeleton

stripQualityTags.description: Strip {Good}/{Bad} quality tags from variable values. Set to "false" to keep them.
